summary: 1min.AI grants free credits without purchase; the marketing page says those credits never expire and lists Daily Visit, reviews, and referrals. The Help Center article titled for this grant (and linking back to 1min.ai/free-credits) states 15,000 credits per day (~450,000/month) requiring daily login to app.1min.ai. The $0 pricing tier lists no credit card required. The 15,000 number is not in the static HTML of /free-credits (client-rendered), so the Help Center quote is the numeric evidence.
claim_steps: Create a free 1min.AI account (pricing page: no credit card required on the $0 plan).
Log in to app.1min.ai each day to receive the daily free-credit grant.
Optional: reviews and referrals can add more credits per the free-credits page headings.
